product.olivetti-m480-30.summary: The M480 server with intelligent MCA disks or GO582 and GO610 SCSI options.
product.olivetti-m480-30.history: In September 1991 Olivetti offered M480-30 (the M480 server with intelligent MCA disks or GO582 and GO610 SCSI options).
product.olivetti-m480-30.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA865 / BA900 / BA952 / BA953 · 82C452 · MCA ESDI / SCSI.
product.olivetti-m480-30.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.06.
product.olivetti-m480-30.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m480-30.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m480-30.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 24-1.
product.olivetti-m480-30.market: Olivetti, La gamma dei personal computer professionali, 3905621C-00, 9/91.
